create_HumanInteractionEnv: create a HumanInteractionEnv instance with an OpenAI client, human prompt template, and model ID
reset_HumanInteractionEnv: reset the HumanInteractionEnv with a problem description and hidden information to start a new dialogue
step_HumanInteractionEnv: step the HumanInteractionEnv with an agent response to advance the dialogue and invoke the model
invoke_model_HumanInteractionEnv: invoke the OpenAI model to generate a human-like response based on the current dialogue history
get_dialogue_history_HumanInteractionEnv: get the dialogue history as a list of role and content message dictionaries
